method.choices: Greedy damage/speed/range strategy chooses only from actual offered buttons; wholly ineffective upgrades are deprioritized. Relics selected from actual three offers.
method.controls: Equipment-aware eight-direction physical-key input at 12 Hz, ordinary collision movement, AStarGrid2D obstacle routing when line of sight is blocked, enemy and environmental telegraph/bullet avoidance, and normal emergency dash. Dash build also dashes offensively. Identical controller/probe source is used for frozen v5 and v6; navigation bounds are derived from the actual arena.
method.damage_definition: Sum of actual HP removed by accepted damage_player calls, after armor/invulnerability and capped at remaining HP on lethal hits; healing does not subtract from this counter.
method.limitations: Small seeded automated sample, not a human difficulty assessment. Perfect knowledge of visible telegraphs favors this controller; collision navigation is approximate and timeouts remain possible. Old/new maps, spawn cadence, population, XP and random offers differ by design. Campaign seeds are matched, not geometry or progression stats. A fixed 240-second per-stage observation limit includes wave downtime.
method.outcomes: Cleared, died, or still alive at the 240-second timeout. A timeout is not a death; clear-time medians exclude timeouts/deaths.
method.progression: Natural full run: real attacks, XP, drops and healing; no injected kills or health resets. Automatic center-portal entry only after combat and all rewards.
